objectives.title: Total Military Personnel
objectives.description: Use the SUM() function to calculate the total number of Military Personnel in the cell range C3:C10 . Locate cell C11 and insert a SUM() function. Use the cell range C3:C10 as the value1 argument. Watch the task video for step-by-step guidance. You can use Prompt#01: Understand Instructions In Context in the project resource file for help with these instructions.

objectives.title: Total Military Deaths
objectives.description: Copy the formula in cell C11 and paste it into cell D11 . Watch the task video for step-by-step guidance. You can use Prompt#01: Understand Instructions In Context in the project resource file for help with these instructions.

objectives.title: Casualty Rate1
objectives.description: Locate cell E3 and input a formula that returns the Casualty Rate. Next, fill it through the range of E4:E11 . Casualty Rate (%) = Military Deaths / Military Personnel Military Deaths = D3 Military Personnel = C3

objectives.title: Absolute References
objectives.description: Locate cell D14 and insert a MAX() function. Use an absolute row reference ( $ ) to define the row numbers in the range of E3:E10 . EXAMPLE: = MAX( value1 )

objectives.title: XLOOKUP Function
objectives.description: Locate cell E14 and insert an XLOOKUP() function. Use a relative cell reference to define the search_key argument. Use an absolute row reference ( $ ) to define the lookup_range and result_range arguments. EXAMPLE: = XLOOKUP( search_key , lookup_range , result_range ) search_key = Highest Casualty Rate cell lookup_range = Casualty Rate range result_range = Country range

objectives.title: Fill Operation
objectives.description: Locate and select the cell range D14:E14 . Use the Fill Operation to fill the formulas through the cell range D16:E16 . Select D15 and change the function to MIN() . Select D16 and change the function to AVERAGE() .

objectives.title: AI & Critical Thinking
objectives.description: Use what you learned in previous tasks and AI to write formulas in cell range D18:E20 that return correct values. You must use absolute row references ( $ ) where appropriate and the following functions to accomplish this task. MAX(), MIN(), AVERAGE(), and XLOOKUP() . No static value allowed. Use the following prompt from the resource File. Prompt#10: Visual Analysis of a Spreadsheet for Formula Help Prompt#10.1: Help with Visual Analysis Formulas

objectives.title: Pie Chart
objectives.description: Create a Pie Chart that displays the number of Military Deaths by Country. Select two non-contiguous ranges, B3:B10 and D3:D10 .

objectives.title: Column Chart
objectives.description: Create a Column Chart that displays the number of Military Personnel by Country. Select two non-contiguous ranges, B3:B10 and C3:C10 .
